description: This file implements the CompositeInput plugin for a media-related system. It handles event registration, JSON-RPC methods for device management, video rectangle setting, and translating hardware events (hotplug, signal change, status update, video mode update) into notifications. It also manages IARM bus event registration and handling for composite input hardware events.

classes.name: CompositeInput
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing JSON-RPC methods, event handling, and hardware event translation for composite input devices.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin; sets up IARM event subscriptions.

methods.name: startCompositeInput
methods.description: Starts composite input on a specified port.

methods.name: stopCompositeInput
methods.description: Stops composite input on all ports.

methods.name: setVideoRectangleWrapper
methods.description: Sets the video rectangle (scale) based on JSON parameters.

methods.name: setVideoRectangle
methods.description: Performs the scale operation on the hardware device.

methods.name: getCompositeInputDevicesWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to retrieve list of input devices.

methods.name: getCompositeInputDevices
methods.description: Retrieves the list of composite input devices with their connection status.

methods.name: compositeInputHotplug
methods.description: Handles hotplug events, notifies system of device change.

methods.name: compositeInputSignalChange
methods.description: Handles signal change events and notifies the system.

methods.name: compositeInputVideoModeUpdate
methods.description: Handles video mode updates and notifies system.

methods.name: dsCompositeEventHandler
methods.description: Static callback for hotplug event from IARM bus.

methods.name: dsCompositeSignalStatusEventHandler
methods.description: Static callback for signal status change from IARM bus.

methods.name: dsCompositeStatusEventHandler
methods.description: Static callback for device status change from IARM bus.

methods.name: dsCompositeVideoModeEventHandler
methods.description: Static callback for video mode update from IARM bus.
